struck: From October 1, 2025 through September 30, 2026, 12,793 homes sold in Horry County, 4,350 of them condos.
use: From October 1, 2025 through September 30, 2026, 12,775 homes sold in Horry County, 4,332 of them condos.

struck: About 3,160 condos sold for under $300,000, and the middle sale price was about $218,000 for a condo.
use: About 3,140 condos sold for under $300,000, and the middle sale price was about $219,000 for a condo.

struck: For condos under $300,000 it was about 1 in 6 (490 of 2,944).
use: For condos under $300,000 it was about 1 in 6 (490 of 2,926).

pattern: (?:only|just) not own a home|must not own a home\b
struck: SC Housing's main program in Horry County does not ask at all: you must only not own a home when the loan closes.
use: SC Housing's main program in Horry County has no first-time rule: you must not own any other property, or a share of one, when the loan closes (bare land is allowed).

struck: A VA loan needs no down payment when the price is not above the appraised value.
use: A VA loan often needs no down payment, as long as the price is not above the appraised value.

struck: A USDA loan needs no down payment.
use: A USDA guaranteed loan can cover the full price, with no down payment, when the home appraises at the price or more; it is for low- and moderate-income buyers in USDA's area.

pattern: \$10,000[^.]{0,160}\bnot owned a (?:main )?home in the (?:last|past) two years
struck: You can take up to $10,000 out of an IRA for a first home without the 10 percent early-withdrawal tax, if you have not owned a main home in the last two years.
use: You can take up to $10,000 out of an IRA for a first home without the 10 percent early-withdrawal tax, if you, and your spouse if you are married, have not owned a main home in the last two years.

struck: In our experience, condo buildings with a rental program are usually not approved for these loans, because so many owners are investors.
use: In our experience, condo buildings with a rental program are usually non-warrantable, because so many owners are investors.

struck: A buyer of a starter house mostly competes with local buyers.
use: Of houses and townhouses that sold for under $300,000, about 1 in 7 have their tax bill mailed to another state; for condos under $300,000 it is about half.

pattern: \b(?:4|four) in (?:5|five) homes\b[^.]{0,60}\bowners\b|\bhomes are lived in by their owners
struck: About 4 in 5 homes are lived in by their owners.
use: About 4 in 5 households in Horry County own their home.

pattern: earnest money (?:goes|is put|is deposited|must go) (?:in|into) the broker'?s trust account
struck: Earnest money goes into the broker's trust account, a check within 48 hours of the signed contract.
use: If a real estate broker holds your earnest money, a check must go into the broker's trust account within 48 hours after both sides accept the offer in writing, not counting weekends and bank holidays.

pattern: (?:deed recording fee|transfer tax|deed stamps?)[^.]{0,80}\bnot the buyer
struck: The deed recording fee, South Carolina's transfer tax, is the seller's, not the buyer's.
use: South Carolina's deed recording fee ($3.70 per $1,000) is owed by the seller, except on a master-in-equity or government deed, such as a HUD home, where the buyer owes it.

struck: Every South Carolina home closing is run by a South Carolina attorney.
use: Every South Carolina home closing must be supervised by a South Carolina attorney.

pattern: flood insurance only when|only (?:when|if) the (?:building|house|home) is in a high-risk flood zone
struck: A lender requires flood insurance only when the building is in a high-risk flood zone.
use: A lender must require flood insurance when the building is in a high-risk flood zone.

struck: Homes east of U.S. 17 or Bypass 17 are in the state's wind pool area, where many policies leave out wind.
use: Homes east of U.S. 17 or Bypass 17, whichever is farther west, are in the state's wind pool area, where insurers may leave wind and hail out of a homeowners policy.

struck: When one comes in low, our agents send the appraiser comparable sales and ask for a reconsideration of value.
use: When one comes in low, our agents gather comparable sales for a reconsideration of value.

pattern: (?:termite|wood infestation)[^.]{0,200}\bnot a warranty|\bnot a warranty\b[^.]{0,80}(?:termite|wood infestation)
struck: The termite letter reports visible damage and infestation; it is not a warranty.
use: The termite letter reports visible damage, infestation and moisture in the parts the inspector can reach, and lists the parts it could not.

pattern: termite letter for a South Carolina sale or mortgage must
struck: A termite letter for a South Carolina sale or mortgage must be on the state's Official Wood Infestation Report form.
use: If a termite letter is issued for a South Carolina sale or mortgage, it must be on the state's official Wood Infestation Report form, signed by a licensed pest control applicator.

struck: Our preferred lender handles the loan; when an SC Housing program fits, we introduce you to an SC Housing approved lender.
use: When an SC Housing program fits, a Chapter3 agent connects you with an SC Housing approved lender.

struck: then in Socastee, southwest of Myrtle Beach
use: then in Socastee, west of Myrtle Beach
